digest.component_or_area: Module size management and code organization
propositions: Six high-centrality, high-churn files sit within 7 LOC of the 800-line cap, blocking new work and requiring proactive decomposition to create headroom.
The headroom in llm/config.py (7 lines) is insufficient for a single new config knob (measured 10-16 lines), blocking ticket d23e's deprecation alias without a structural prerequisite.
Module-level refactoring using domain-shape-driven extraction (absorbing verbs, flat tables, colocated domains) must precede dependent work to avoid mid-flight size breaches.
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets under 700 LOC serve as the substitute ratchet for a declined per-function length gate, making them load-bearing guardrails.
llm/config.py, workflow_ops.py, gate_context.py, and decide_ops.py have been relieved and now meet their respective LOC targets with real headroom and zero test edits.
